kick.en: And it’s a limited-time thing. When it expires, it’s real power kicks in, says Ariely.
kick.zh: 而且这是一个限时活动。Ariely 说，当它过期时，真正的威力就开始显现了。

kick.en: To give something a kick means to provide it with extra stimulation or excitement.
kick.zh: To give something a kick 意思是给某物带来额外的刺激或兴奋感。

kick.en: He measures player's brainwaves before these important kicks and teaches them how to stay relaxed.
kick.zh: 他测量了球员在这些重要射门前的脑电波，并教导他们如何保持放松。

kick.en: It's like an exclamation mark. Exactly. Mathilde says pepper gives food a kick.
kick.zh: 就像一个感叹号。没错。Mathilde 说胡椒能给食物带来一种 kick（刺激感）。

kick.en: If you're mentally all over the place, it's more difficult to kick the ball accurately.
kick.zh: 如果你脑子里乱作一团，把球踢准就会变得更难。

kindness.en: Now, Strongbow was not doing this out of the kindness of his heart.
kindness.zh: Strongbow 这样做并不是出于好心。

kindness.en: Showing kindness, which helps us to develop connection with other people.
kindness.zh: 表现出善良，这有助于我们发展与其他人的联系。

kindness.en: While richer countries scored higher on material happiness, middle-income countries did better in terms of kindness and social connection.
kindness.zh: 虽然较富裕的国家在物质幸福感上得分更高，但中等收入国家在善良和社会联系方面表现更好。

kindness.en: And I enjoyed it. I enjoyed my customers; I enjoyed the kindness, and I enjoyed every part of it.
kindness.zh: 我很享受。我很享受我的客户；我享受那种善意，并且我享受其中的每一部分。

kindness.en: At the Planks's and eventually at the Kingdom Hall, Will found kindness, acceptance, and engagement amongst the brothers and sisters there.
kindness.zh: 在Plank家里，后来在王国聚会所里，Will在那里的弟兄姐妹身上感受到了善良、接纳和关怀。

kit.en: Putting on a marionette show requires a large stage and quite a lot of kit.
kit.zh: 上演一场提线木偶戏需要一个大舞台和相当多的装备。

kit.en: Now, I have to confess that I have never tried it, but it does appear that the swazzle is not an easy piece of kit to use.
kit.zh: 现在，我必须承认我从未尝试过，但看起来 swazzle 确实不是一个好驾驭的装备。

kit.en: It’s now believed that he swam a little out into the water and then swam along the shore to the beach of another hotel, retrieved his “getaway kit”, which he had stashed earlier, and then made a beeline for, he rushed to, Miami airport.
kit.zh: 现在人们认为，他先向海里游了一小段，然后沿着海岸游到另一家酒店的海滩，取回了他早先藏好的“逃跑装备”，然后直奔迈阿密机场。

kit.en: When the test returned some unexpected results, Chris called BBC Radio 4 programme, Sliced Bread, wondering how accurate they really were: Not so long ago I sent off a home DNA testing kit and the results that came back were broadly in line with expectations, but it had some little glitches in there which made me think, is this accurate?
kit.zh: 当测试得出一些意想不到的结果时，克里斯给BBC广播四台的节目《Sliced Bread》打去了电话，想知道这些测试到底有多准确：不久前我寄出了一套家用DNA测试套件，返回的结果大致符合预期，但里面有一些小故障，这让我不禁思考，这到底准不准呢？

kingdom.en: One of the clearest examples comes from the 2016 Brexit Referendum in the United Kingdom.
kingdom.zh: 最清晰的例子之一来自2016年英国脱欧公投。

kingdom.en: The United Kingdom is formed of four countries: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland.
kingdom.zh: 大不列颠及北爱尔兰联合王国由四个国家组成：英格兰、威尔士、苏格兰和北爱尔兰。

kingdom.en: Instead, there were various different city states, regions, and kingdoms across the area.
kingdom.zh: 相反，该地区有各种不同的城邦、地区和王国。

kingdom.en: Bengal--the textile revolution began in Bengal and actually then migrated to the United Kingdom.
kingdom.zh: 孟加拉——纺织业革命最早就发端于孟加拉，后来才转移到了英国。

kingdom.en: This is partly because of the historical influence of the United Kingdom and the United States.
kingdom.zh: 这部分是因为英国和美国在历史上的影响力。

kidnap.en: And in the final part, part three, we’ll talk about Kim Jong-il’s obsession with cinema, and how this led him to kidnap one of South Korea’s most famous directors.
kidnap.zh: 而在最后一集，也就是第三集，我们会讲金正日(Kim Jong-il)对电影的痴迷，以及这份痴迷如何让他绑架了韩国最著名的导演之一。

kidnap.en: Even worse was the impact of slavery. In the 19th century, slave traders kidnapped hundreds of Rapa Nui people and forced them to work in mines and plantations in South America.
kidnap.zh: 更糟糕的是奴隶贸易带来的冲击。在19世纪，奴隶贩子绑架了数百名 Rapa Nui 人，强迫他们在南美洲的矿山和种植园里劳作。

kidnap.en: Next up we’ll be talking about the brazen daylight murder of Kim Jong-un’s brother, and in part three it’ll be Kim Jong-il’s peculiar love for cinema, and how that led him to kidnapping a famous South Korean director.
kidnap.zh: 接下来我们会讲金正恩的哥哥在光天化日之下被公然杀害的事件，而在第三集里，我们会讲金正日对电影那份奇特的热爱，以及这份热爱如何让他绑架了一位著名的韩国导演。

kindle.en: You can publish books online, onto Kindle for example, without needing a publisher.
kindle.zh: 你可以在网上出版书籍，比如发布到 Kindle 上，而不需要出版商。

kindle.en: Things like the Amazon Kindle have changed how we read.
kindle.zh: 像 Amazon Kindle 这样的设备改变了我们的阅读方式。

kindle.en: I think the Kindle for offers is $1.99. Our mission is to make real business education accessible for everyone. $100 million leads has been six hours a day, 6 AM to 12 PM every day for the last two years.
kindle.zh: 我认为《Offers》的Kindle版是1.99美元。我们的使命是让每个人都能获得真正的商业教育。《$100 Million Leads》在过去两年里每天花费我六个小时，从早上6点到中午12点。

kidney.en: Like, you know, look at how much of the federal budget goes into dialysis because of kidney failure.
kidney.zh: 比如，看看联邦预算中有多少钱花在肾衰竭的透析上。
